sourceNotes.rawContent: Pure bridal opulence — this extraordinary Kashmiri bracelet watch is adorned with intricate kundan mandala medallions framed in deep green meenakari and bordered with delicate seed pearls, flanking a unique square star-dial quartz watch face. An adjustable pearl-drop slider chain with ghungroo bells ensures a perfect fit on every wrist. This is not just a watch — it is a heritage jewellery piece that tells a story of royal Indian craftsmanship with every glance. A dream piece for brides, bridesmaids, and festive queens alike.
